quest.title: Parting Arrangement
quest.description: Fungus Mechanicus's testing phase is coming to a close. It's time to give Haniyyah and Balfour some feedback...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: #Thank you for your work these past few days, Golden Comet {NICKNAME} and Silver Companion!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: I've logged all your games, and we've been able to gather lots of data from your game records.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: You fall under the category we call "pinnacle-class" players, and I believe that between you and normal testers, we'll be able to come up with some stable improvement directives.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Of course, we'd also like to hear what you thought of the game overall, and if you have any suggestions in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Your feedback will not only have a positive impact on Fungus Mechanicus, but will also affect the next tournament to some extent.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Finally, we'd like to hear about your general preferences... Would you prefer novelty, or more competitive aspects?

choices.text: I'd prefer to emphasize cooperation between companions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! Competitive clashes are really important, sure, but we'd prefer that future challenges test the bonds between us and our Fungi friends!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bonds, huh... Alright, I understand.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Mr. Balfour. Do you remember what I told you about the most important idea?

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Understood! I shall endeavor to design more challenges that will test your coordination with one another, where effective communication will allow you and your Fungi friends to unleash your true potential!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Same as always, huh, you two...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Regardless, that's it for this round of Fungus Mechanicus tests.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice! Now that we're done with work, it's time to collect our pay and get some food to reward ourselves, hehe!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... That's not right! We're the organizers of the next tournament, while Haniyyah and Balfour are making preparations for it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haniyyah's our awesome assistant, and Balfour's also being employed by us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean we'll have to, uh... pay our employees for their hard work... and stuff?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Oh, no, that's not necessary. In fact, that's too kind of you! I volunteered to do this job, and I learned a lot from it, too!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I mean, I'm someone from the mercantile industry as well, so the experience of managing Fungus Mechanicus has been quite valuable to me.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: If this work were to be open to the public, I'm quite sure you'd have no lack of offers from people who'd like to buy the rights to it, to be honest!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: And once Fungus Mechanicus starts turning a profit, Mr. Balfour should make his investment back and a large portion of the profits will go to me.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I will then set a portion of that aside for use as funds for the next tournament, and another portion will be used to take care of our shroom friends.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: And by that I don't just mean Bongo-Head, but also the Fungi that the other contestants have entrusted to me, like Stormstress.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In other words, the improvements you're helping us make to Fungus Mechanicus will not only make us all a tidy profit, but will also go into securing welfare for the Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so that's it... Well, Paimon doesn't get all this profit and earnings stuff, but it sounds like everyone wins, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's feeling that sense of accomplishment already!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If we get the chance, {NICKNAME}, we should tell our friends in Sumeru about Fungus Mechanicus. Gotta spread the word and everything!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course, of course.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I'll be heading out of the city with our Fungi friends to meet up with my assistant, and then we'll return to our campsite.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The Fungi who stay at the campsite will get worried if we're away for too long.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Mr. Balfour will stay here to promote the test version of Fungus Mechanicus, so if you've not yet had your fill of fun, you can keep playing.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Indeed! Play to your heart's content!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, you're going already, Haniyyah? With Bongo-Head and the rest?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon still wants to play with Bongo-Head...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But meeting you again has definitely put Paimon at ease!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It was especially great to see that our shroom buddies are all right as rain, and that we're just as tight as we used to be!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Don't worry. I believe we'll meet again soon.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Though the two of you are constantly traveling, I do have some means of contacting you — for example, we can send you letters through the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I'm sure that when we next meet, our friends will be both healthy and hearty!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Just hang tight and wait for good news from me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! We believe in you, Haniyyah!

choices.text: Keep up the good work, Haniyyah.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: We'll see you next time then, Golden Comet and Silver Companion!

choices.text: And don't forget to take care of yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, right. Hehe, food bought with hard-earned Mora tastes so much better!

choices.text: I'm partial towards the elegance and thrill of combat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Paimon's also sure that our bonds with our shroom buddies will only become stronger, and won't weaken with time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knows how well we'll work together the next time we compete? There's no doubt that we'll need the coolest battles to put that on display!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I see. So you're of a mind that suitable challenges can display the full strength of the Fungi.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: In that case, we'll increase the number of challenging events available during the next competition!

choices.text: I'm not partial to anything. Let's just do something enjoyable!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. No matter what happens, we'll be happy so long as we can play with our shroom buddies, clear challenges with them, and overcome difficulties together!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Understood. So we'd want a mix of fun and challenge, huh? It sounds simple, but might be harder to execute...

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: Leave it to me. I shall do my best to satisfy your requirements!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The timing's just right, and we've spent quite a bit of time testing Fungus Mechanicus, haven't we?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we can go look for Haniyyah and Balfour right about now to give them some feedback, huh?
